targets.name: modafinil

source_evidence.label: ACS supporting information for 10.1021/cg030069t
source_evidence.evidence: ACS lists free supporting-information CIF files cg030069t1.cif, cg030069t2.cif, and cg030069t3.cif for modafinil daughter, mother, and minimized mother phases.

source_evidence.label: CCDC deposition clue
source_evidence.evidence: The article states that crystallographic data are deposited at CCDC under number 229171.

source_evidence.label: CCDC Access Structures route
source_evidence.evidence: CCDC Access Structures can search by deposition number or DOI and can provide CIF downloads after accepting use conditions.

download_attempts.observed_issue: ACS direct supporting-information request did not return a usable CIF in the local shell session.

local_coordinate_sources.notes: Contains parent modafinil blocks plus hydrate, co-crystal, solvate, and related blocks that must remain role-labeled.

required_user_input: Confirm whether the downloaded modafinil CIF bundle may be used only locally or may also be referenced in a public evidence bundle.

targets.name: atomoxetine hydrochloride

source_evidence.label: Powder Diffraction article
source_evidence.evidence: Reports commercial atomoxetine hydrochloride in P212121 with cell parameters and a solved/refined powder-diffraction structure.

source_evidence.label: Secondary CSD clue
source_evidence.evidence: Secondary rendering cites CCDC CSD 1519130 for the 2014 atomoxetine hydrochloride structure.

source_evidence.label: CCDC Access Structures route
source_evidence.evidence: Search by CSD number, DOI, compound name, or publication details should validate whether coordinates can be downloaded.

local_coordinate_sources.notes: Contains CCDC 1519130 and related atomoxetine hydrochloride records.

required_user_input: Confirm whether the atomoxetine hydrochloride CIF bundle may be used only locally or may also be referenced in a public evidence bundle.

targets.name: methylphenidate hydrochloride

source_evidence.label: threo-methylphenidate hydrochloride crystal-data clue
source_evidence.evidence: A Wikimedia rendering cites X-ray diffraction data from Pharm. Res. (1995) 12, 1430-1434, DOI 10.1023/A:1016262815984, for (-)-threo-methylphenidate hydrochloride.

source_evidence.label: N-methyl methylphenidate derivative paper
source_evidence.evidence: Reports single-crystal structures for N-methyl derivatives of threo-methylphenidate hydrochloride salts; useful as proxy chemistry, not parent methylphenidate proof.

source_evidence.label: Alkyl analogue paper and COD examples
source_evidence.evidence: Reports X-ray crystallographic studies of alkyl analogues of methylphenidate salts; COD has open analogue entries such as 4026734, but these are not the target parent salt.

local_coordinate_sources.notes: Contains one parent methylphenidate hydrochloride candidate plus related N-methyl/dimethyl analogues.

required_user_input: Confirm whether the parent methylphenidate hydrochloride CIF block may be used only locally or may also be referenced in a public evidence bundle.
Do not substitute methylphenidate analogues for methylphenidate hydrochloride in benchmark claims; keep analogues as source-search clues only.

policy: A public article page or rendering is not equivalent to reusable crystal coordinates.
CIF downloads from CCDC Access Structures require accepting conditions of use and recording local redistribution limits.
Analogue crystal structures may guide source discovery but cannot validate a parent medication benchmark.
Failed automated downloads must remain visible so the next operator knows exactly where manual input is needed.
